newsitem.title: USA: Exxon in China petrochemical joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Exxon in China petrochemical joint venture.

text.p: Exxon Corp said Wednesday it is participating in a multi-billion dollar joint venture to expand a refinery and build a petrochemical complex in the Chinese Fujian province.

A spokeswoman said the oil company had been selected as the only foreign company in the joint venture with Fujian Petrochemical Co Ltd, which itself is a joint venture of China Petrochemical Corp and the Fujian province.
She added the joint venture partners are now studying the feasability of the project.

The project calls for expanding an existing refinery's capacity to 240,000 barrels a day from 80,000 barrels a day and building a ethylene steam cracker with a capacity of 600,000 tons per year and chemical derivatives plants in Xiaocuo, Fujian province.
